description: Mutations for preset file ownership, inheritance, and bundle material workflows.

mutants.description: Drop the modified marker from a dirty preset label; the alias and no-alias label contract should distinguish the change.
Allow bundle presets to write standalone metadata; embedded and bundled save-info ownership is intentionally separate.
Invert the project-embedded remove-files guard; detached embedded-preset lifecycle checks should expose file deletion.
Disable copying the previous preset when growing a nonempty filament list; sizing and selected preset inheritance should expose it.
Invert application of a requested color to newly created slots; the exact color contract must fail.
Invert the absent mixed-slot metadata guard; physical and mixed filament accounting should expose the invalid early return.
Select virtual mixed slots instead of physical slots; the explicit index and physical-count contract should detect it.
Stop adding project identity keys to the differing-key set; the deterministic key inventory should detect the missing defaults.
Invert recognition of supported machines; known H2D names must gain the nozzle suffix while unknown machines preserve their names.
Require both fallback conditions instead of either; a missing model must still resolve to the configured fallback hotend asset.
